usedFor: Fathom records your meetings, and Slack shares what came out of them when “New Action Item” runs “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Action Item” in Fathom, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Each action item from a meeting reaches a Slack channel, so owners see their follow-ups right away.

watchOut: An automation's “Send Message” post to a Slack channel waits for your approval today, so expect a tap first.
